name: Glass Sand
author: Brandon
description:
Made with the Sandustry Material Studio.

A reworked economy. Sand is glass feedstock now: drop it on a powered Smelter and it converts 1:1 into glass, a pale solid a touch lighter than sand.

Gold comes from SOIL instead. Wet Soil - made by touching Soil to water (the water is soaked up) - refines on the Shaker exactly like wet sand used to: gold drops out the bottom, residue is thrown out the top.

Wet Sand is stripped from the game: sand that gets wet instantly dries back into sand, so the old wet-sand gold path is gone.

Soil has no natural source yet - spawn it with testing tools.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the mod off without unsubscribing. Recipes can only be withdrawn at load, so switching off leaves them until the next restart.
